Yes. The change requires access to Forward+ render-list classification, framebuffer attachments, spatial shader variants, and the engine-owned previous/current transform data. An add-on cannot safely insert per-material velocity writes into the built-in transparent draw pass. Keeping the option in core also lets TAA, temporal upscalers, the motion-vector debug view, and compositor effects share one documented behavior.

answers.workaround: No. Scripts and compositor effects can read the engine motion-vector texture, but they cannot make a transparent spatial draw write the correct per-pixel previous/current clip-space motion into that texture. A project can make a material opaque or fake speed with trails/stretching, but those approaches change the look and do not solve the general transparent temporal-reprojection problem.

title: Add opt-in motion vector writes for transparent spatial materials
